title: How a P-Trap Protects Indoor Air
description: A P-trap serves as a vital hydraulic seal beneath sink fixtures. As wastewater drains down the sink tailpiece, it flows through the curved dip of the trap and out toward the main drain stack. Once water stops running, gravity holds a standing volume of water within the lower bend. This standing water forms an airtight liquid seal between the sewer system and the room, stopping sewer gases from escaping while allowing liquids and fine solids to flow through smoothly.

How a P-Trap Protects Indoor Air

A P-trap serves as a vital hydraulic seal beneath sink fixtures. As wastewater drains down the sink tailpiece, it flows through the curved dip of the trap and out toward the main drain stack. Once water stops running, gravity holds a standing volume of water within the lower bend. This standing water forms an airtight liquid seal between the sewer system and the room, stopping sewer gases from escaping while allowing liquids and fine solids to flow through smoothly.
